  <rdfs:label>Open Source Development</rdfs:label>

</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CommunityDevelopment">

  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 names it as a development model</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms and may be modified.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 supply Tool as the subject for uses and modification relations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A defined procedure or set of rules used by a tool.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 name Algorithm as the range of uses and domain of modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>Computer programs and applications that perform tasks, process data, and provide features.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Serves as the central class for most competency questions regarding capabilities, formats, licenses, and metadata</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature">
  <rdfs:comment>A capability or functionality provided by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Feature</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 and CQ55 ask about features provided or included in versions</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Api">
  <rdfs:comment>An interface allowing software components to communicate.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>API</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DesktopApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software designed to run on a personal computer.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Desktop Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software accessed via a web browser.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Library">
  <rdfs:comment>A collection of precompiled routines for use by other programs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Library</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific operation or goal that software can perform.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08, CQ14, and CQ16 ask about tasks performed or supported by software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService">
  <rdfs:comment>A software system designed to support interoperable machine-to-machine interaction over a network.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Service</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 asks if software is available as a web service</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software instrument used to generate or manipulate data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 distinguishes SoftwareTool as the creator of data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Information processed, created, or exchanged by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15, CQ16, and CQ23 involve data creation, compatibility, and interoperability</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format">
  <rdfs:comment>A specification for structuring data or files.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 and CQ26 ask about input/output formats and processing capabilities</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FileFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A way in which information is encoded for storage in a computer file.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>File Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ19 asks about reading specific file formats like .cel</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputData">
  <rdfs:comment>Data accepted as valid input by software or versions.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ21 and CQ29 ask about valid inputs and accepted inputs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A general category for formats used to structure data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 uses it as the superclass for proprietary and open formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProprietaryFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A data format owned or controlled by a specific entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Proprietary Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting from proprietary formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf DataFormat -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A publicly available data format that can be used by multiple vendors.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting to open formats like csv or txt</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf DataFormat -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareVersion">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific release or iteration of software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29, CQ55, and CQ57 ask about version-specific features, exports, inputs, and release dates</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?
    (competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ExportData">
  <rdfs:comment>Data produced as output by a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Export Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks about data exports for a given version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>Documentation or support material for using software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ32 asks how to get help</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer">
  <rdfs:comment>An individual or organization that creates software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36 and CQ38 ask about developers and collaboration channels</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CollaborationChannel">
  <rdfs:comment>A medium or platform for interacting with software developers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Collaboration Channel</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 asks about collaborating with developers</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Documentation">
  <rdfs:comment>Written or digital material describing software usage and features.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Documentation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ73 asks where documentation is located</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProgrammingLanguage">
  <rdfs:comment>A formal language used to write instructions for computers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Programming Language</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ84 asks about the implementation language of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Platform">
  <rdfs:comment>The hardware or software environment on which software runs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Platform</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ85 asks about supported platforms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DevelopmentModel">
  <rdfs:comment>The methodology or community structure used to develop software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Development Model</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks about open source or community development models</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#License">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal permission defining how software may be used and distributed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>License</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks about licenses and their permissiveness</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

  <!-- owl:ObjectProperty declarations -->

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#uses">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a tool to the algorithm it employs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Uses</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 connects Tool to Algorithm</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Tool -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Algorithm -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#modification">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an algorithm to its modifications.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 connects Algorithm to Modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Algorithm -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Modification -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#provides">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a feature it offers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Provides</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 connects Software to Feature</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Feature -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#performs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a task it executes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Performs</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 and CQ14 connect Software to Task</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Task -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#availableAs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a web service deployment.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Available As</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 connects Software to WebService</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range WebService -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#creates">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a software tool to the data it generates.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Creates</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 connects SoftwareTool to Data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain SoftwareTool -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#supports">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a task it facilitates.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Supports</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ16 connects Software to Task</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Task -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#compatibleWith">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to data it can work with.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Compatible With</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ16 connects Software to Data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#hasFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>General property relating software to a data format it handles.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] coined: Unifies inputFormat and outputFormat which share domain Software and range Format</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#inputFormat">

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms and may be modified.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 supply Tool as the subject for uses and modification relations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A defined procedure or set of rules used by a tool.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 name Algorithm as the range of uses and domain of modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?

    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?

    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>

<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms and may be modified.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 supply Tool as the subject for uses and modification relations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A defined procedure or set of rules used by a tool.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 name Algorithm as the range of uses and domain of modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>Computer programs and applications that perform tasks, process data, and provide features.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Serves as the central class for most competency questions regarding capabilities, formats, licenses, and metadata</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature">
  <rdfs:comment>A capability or functionality provided by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Feature</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 and CQ55 ask about features provided or included in versions</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Api">
  <rdfs:comment>An interface allowing software components to communicate.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>API</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DesktopApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software designed to run on a personal computer.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Desktop Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software accessed via a web browser.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Library">
  <rdfs:comment>A collection of precompiled routines for use by other programs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Library</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific operation or goal that software can perform.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08, CQ14, and CQ16 ask about tasks performed or supported by software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService">
  <rdfs:comment>A software system designed to support interoperable machine-to-machine interaction over a network.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Service</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 asks if software is available as a web service</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software instrument used to generate or manipulate data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 distinguishes SoftwareTool as the creator of data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Information processed, created, or exchanged by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15, CQ16, and CQ23 involve data creation, compatibility, and interoperability</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format">
  <rdfs:comment>A specification for structuring data or files.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 and CQ26 ask about input/output formats and processing capabilities</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FileFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A way in which information is encoded for storage in a computer file.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>File Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ19 asks about reading specific file formats like .cel</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputData">
  <rdfs:comment>Data accepted as valid input by software or versions.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ21 and CQ29 ask about valid inputs and accepted inputs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A general category for formats used to structure data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 uses it as the superclass for proprietary and open formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProprietaryFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A data format owned or controlled by a specific entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Proprietary Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting from proprietary formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf DataFormat -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A publicly available data format that can be used by multiple vendors.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting to open formats like csv or txt</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf DataFormat -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareVersion">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific release or iteration of software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29, CQ55, and CQ57 ask about version-specific features, exports, inputs, and release dates</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?
    (competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ExportData">
  <rdfs:comment>Data produced as output by a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Export Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks about data exports for a given version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>Documentation or support material for using software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ32 asks how to get help</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer">
  <rdfs:comment>An individual or organization that creates software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36 and CQ38 ask about developers and collaboration channels</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CollaborationChannel">
  <rdfs:comment>A medium or platform for interacting with software developers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Collaboration Channel</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 asks about collaborating with developers</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Documentation">
  <rdfs:comment>Written or digital material describing software usage and features.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Documentation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ73 asks where documentation is located</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProgrammingLanguage">
  <rdfs:comment>A formal language used to write instructions for computers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Programming Language</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ84 asks about the implementation language of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Platform">
  <rdfs:comment>The hardware or software environment on which software runs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Platform</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ85 asks about supported platforms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DevelopmentModel">
  <rdfs:comment>The methodology or community structure used to develop software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Development Model</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks about open source or community development models</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#License">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal permission defining how software may be used and distributed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>License</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks about licenses and their permissiveness</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

  <!-- owl:ObjectProperty declarations -->

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#uses">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a tool to the algorithm it employs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Uses</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 connects Tool to Algorithm</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Tool -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Algorithm -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#modification">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an algorithm to its modifications.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 connects Algorithm to Modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Algorithm -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Modification -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#provides">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a feature it offers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Provides</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 connects Software to Feature</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Feature -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#performs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a task it executes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Performs</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 and CQ14 connect Software to Task</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Task -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#availableAs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a web service deployment.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Available As</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 connects Software to WebService</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range WebService -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#creates">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a software tool to the data it generates.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Creates</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 connects SoftwareTool to Data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain SoftwareTool -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#supports">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a task it facilitates.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Supports</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ16 connects Software to Task</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Task -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#compatibleWith">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to data it can work with.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Compatible With</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ16 connects Software to Data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#hasFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>General property relating software to a data format it handles.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] coined: Unifies inputFormat and outputFormat which share domain Software and range Format</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#inputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a format it accepts as input.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for input formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#hasFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf hasFormat -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#outputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a format it produces as output.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Output Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for output formats</vaem:rationale>

  <rdfs:label>TXT</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 names it as an open format</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenFormat"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareA">
  <rdfs:comment>Placeholder software for interoperability queries.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software A</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ23 uses it as an instance of Software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareB">
  <rdfs:comment>Placeholder software for interoperability queries.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software B</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ23 uses it as an instance of Software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputX">
  <rdfs:comment>Placeholder input data for version queries.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input X</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 uses it as an instance of InputData</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputData"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ThisVersion">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software version under inquiry.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>This Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 and CQ55 use it as an instance of SoftwareVersion</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareVersion"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareX">
  <rdfs:comment>Placeholder software for collaboration queries.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software X</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 uses it as an instance of Software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version1_0">
  <rdfs:comment>The initial 1.0 release of a software product.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Version 1.0</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ57 uses it as an instance of SoftwareVersion</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareVersion"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenSourceDevelopment">
  <rdfs:comment>A development model where source code is publicly accessible.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Source Development</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 names it as a development model</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DevelopmentModel"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CommunityDevelopment">
  <rdfs:comment>A development model driven by a collaborative community.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Community Development</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 names it as a development model</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DevelopmentModel"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

</rdf:RDF>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms and may be modified.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 supply Tool as the subject for uses and modification relations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A defined procedure or set of rules used by a tool.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 name Algorithm as the range of uses and domain of modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>Computer programs and applications that perform tasks, process data, and provide features.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Serves as the central class for most competency questions regarding capabilities, formats, licenses, and metadata</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature">
  <rdfs:comment>A capability or functionality provided by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Feature</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 and CQ55 ask about features provided or included in versions</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Api">
  <rdfs:comment>An interface allowing software components to communicate.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>API</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DesktopApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software designed to run on a personal computer.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Desktop Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software accessed via a web browser.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Library">
  <rdfs:comment>A collection of precompiled routines for use by other programs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Library</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists it as a type of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific operation or goal that software can perform.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08, CQ14, and CQ16 ask about tasks performed or supported by software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService">
  <rdfs:comment>A software system designed to support interoperable machine-to-machine interaction over a network.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Service</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 asks if software is available as a web service</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software instrument used to generate or manipulate data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 distinguishes SoftwareTool as the creator of data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Information processed, created, or exchanged by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15, CQ16, and CQ23 involve data creation, compatibility, and interoperability</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format">
  <rdfs:comment>A specification for structuring data or files.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 and CQ26 ask about input/output formats and processing capabilities</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FileFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A way in which information is encoded for storage in a computer file.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>File Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ19 asks about reading specific file formats like .cel</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputData">
  <rdfs:comment>Data accepted as valid input by software or versions.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ21 and CQ29 ask about valid inputs and accepted inputs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A general category for formats used to structure data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 uses it as the superclass for proprietary and open formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProprietaryFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A data format owned or controlled by a specific entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Proprietary Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting from proprietary formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf DataFormat -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A publicly available data format that can be used by multiple vendors.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting to open formats like csv or txt</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf DataFormat -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareVersion">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific release or iteration of software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29, CQ55, and CQ57 ask about version-specific features, exports, inputs, and release dates</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?
    (competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ExportData">
  <rdfs:comment>Data produced as output by a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Export Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks about data exports for a given version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>Documentation or support material for using software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ32 asks how to get help</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer">
  <rdfs:comment>An individual or organization that creates software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36 and CQ38 ask about developers and collaboration channels</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CollaborationChannel">
  <rdfs:comment>A medium or platform for interacting with software developers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Collaboration Channel</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 asks about collaborating with developers</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Documentation">
  <rdfs:comment>Written or digital material describing software usage and features.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Documentation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ73 asks where documentation is located</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProgrammingLanguage">
  <rdfs:comment>A formal language used to write instructions for computers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Programming Language</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ84 asks about the implementation language of software</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Platform">
  <rdfs:comment>The hardware or software environment on which software runs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Platform</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ85 asks about supported platforms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DevelopmentModel">
  <rdfs:comment>The methodology or community structure used to develop software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Development Model</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks about open source or community development models</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#License">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal permission defining how software may be used and distributed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>License</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks about licenses and their permissiveness</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

  <!-- owl:ObjectProperty declarations -->

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#uses">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a tool to the algorithm it employs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Uses</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 connects Tool to Algorithm</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Tool -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Algorithm -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#modification">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an algorithm to its modifications.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 connects Algorithm to Modification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Algorithm -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Modification -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#provides">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a feature it offers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Provides</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 connects Software to Feature</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Feature -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#performs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to a task it executes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Performs</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 and CQ14 connect Software to Task</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
